title: Daily habit tracker
description: Records one habit entry (habit, value, note) as a line in habits/log.csv. Press Run to log a sample, or add a webhook under ⋯ > Triggers and call it from a phone shortcut or script with {"habit": "walk", "value": 30, "note": "evening"}. Pair it with Weekly habit stats. Needs nothing else.
name: Daily habit tracker
